parameters.question: Compare PCoA coordinates (beta diversity ordination from 16S ASV table) per sample. Coordinates must match the reference within +/-0.05 per axis; each axis may be globally sign-flipped (multiply entire axis by -1), and column/row order may differ. Align rows by sample ID.

Compare PERMANOVA results tables (beta diversity between sample groups from 16S ASV table). R^2 and F-statistic must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error; Pr(>F) (permutation-based) need only agree in significance direction (p < 0.05); row and column order may differ.

Compare differential abundance results per ASV from 16S amplicon data: match rows by ASV identifier and check that log2FoldChange and padj agree with the reference within 1% relative absolute error. Row and column order may differ.
